scope: Representative real saved model and BstBaked terrain GLSL families through production GPU bindings, real texture and bake bytes. Raw linear HDR is measured before tonemapping. Large HDR is a triage signal, not automatically a shader defect. Not all instances, complete scene lighting or original Metal/game pixel parity.
